searchText: <Souptacular> @protolambda I have added you to the new #eth2 Telegram room that is bridged with Discord. Apparently the old one was set-up by someone else, so we made a new room :) Enjoy! <protolambda> @Souptacular Can you assign some moderators in this group, and create an invite link (I can't seem to, think it's a permissions thing). I'll notify the old group of the change. Thanks Hey all - want to verify something regarding ETH2 withdrawal keys. Is it OK to re-use the same withdrawal key for multiple validators? I.e. if we are generating many validator nodes, each with different validator keys, but the same withdrawal key, we will be able to use the single withdrawal key to successfully claim funds once the network supports it? It is safe, but it does leak information that the validators are tied together if you use the standard EIPs for key-generation then it will use a separate withdrawal key for each validator that said, it is safe, just not standard, to reuse the withdrawal cred Thanks - we aren't able to use the standard EIPs unfortunately as we are using threshold multisig keys as withdrawal keys

excerpts.author: mtoda8639
excerpts.content:
Hey all - want to verify something regarding ETH2 withdrawal keys. Is it OK to re-use the same withdrawal key for multiple validators? 
I.e. if we are generating many validator nodes, each with different validator keys, but the same withdrawal key, we will be able to use the single withdrawal key to successfully claim funds once the network supports it?

excerpts.author: djrtwo
excerpts.content: It is safe, but it does leak information that the validators are tied together

excerpts.author: djrtwo
excerpts.content: if you use the standard EIPs for key-generation then it will use a separate withdrawal key for each validator

excerpts.author: djrtwo
excerpts.content: that said, it is safe, just not standard, to reuse the withdrawal cred

excerpts.author: mtoda8639
excerpts.content: Thanks - we aren't able to use the standard EIPs unfortunately as we are using threshold multisig keys as withdrawal keys
